report.title: Decimal amount transfer fails due to timeout
report.summary: The test for decimal amount transfer fails due to a timeout error. The test is expecting the page to be visible with a specific text.
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Open the ParaBank website and navigate to the Transfer Funds page.
2. Attempt to transfer an amount with decimal places (e.g. 100.50).
report.expected: The page should be visible with the text '$100.50 has been transferred'.
report.actual: Locator.wait_for: Timeout 2000ms exceeded. Locator waited for: locator("#amt")
report.suspected_cause: The test is waiting for a locator that is not present on the page.
report.next_action: Review the test code and ensure that the locator is correct and the page is behaving as expected.
